fm_reference: FM24 League/Competition screens: table, fixtures & results, cup bracket, season stats

history.gap: No click-through navigation: table/fixtures/stats rows are dead ends - club and Pokemon names never link to profiles, unlike FM24 where every entity is hyperlinked.

No Stats Centre depth: only four fixed top-7 leader cards and zero sortable/filterable columns anywhere; FM24 offers full sortable all-player stat tables with many categories and home/away/form table splits.

Stats Centre is players-only: there is no team/club statistics view - FM24's Stats Centre pairs its player tables with full sortable TEAM stat tables (and Data Hub-style visual analytics) that managers use to scout opponents; add a Teams mode to the Stats Centre (sortable club-level table: home/away splits, battle-win %, KO difference, avg squad rating, streaks) to close the last functional gap in this area.

Stats Centre breadth and visual analytics: FM24's competition stats offer far more metrics with customisable views, percentile context and Data Hub-grade charts (plus a table position graph); Trainer Manager's stats are 12 player / 25 team metrics in fixed categories and the entire suite is tables-only - not a single chart, sparkline or position-over-time graph anywhere.

Data integrity of replay-derived match data: fixture_detail() re-simulates with the current squad state, so ~9% of played fixtures (3/32 in the live save) show match reports contradicting the recorded score - cup tie C101 renders a 2-1 header over two battles won by the losing club, and season stats/POTM are credited from those contradicted replays. Persist detail at play time for instant sims like interactive matches already do.
